name: ME Bake

description.short: Bake geometry into Rhino with Meanders attributes.
description.long: Bakes geometry or ME Objects into the active Rhino document. A Meanders Attribute can be supplied and defaults to an empty ME Attribute. Baking is triggered by changing the Bake input from false to true. When Group branch items is enabled, which is the default, baked objects from each Grasshopper branch are placed into a Rhino group.

inputs.name: Geometry
inputs.description: Geometry or ME Objects to bake.

inputs.name: Attribute
inputs.description: Meanders attributes to apply while baking. Defaults to an empty ME Attribute.

inputs.name: Bake
inputs.description: Triggers baking when changed from false to true. Defaults to false.

examples.title: Bake branch geometry
examples.description: Set Bake to true to bake the supplied geometry. With Group branch items enabled, each Grasshopper branch is baked into its own Rhino group.

notes: The Bake input defaults to false.
Baking occurs only on a false-to-true transition of the Bake input.
Changing Geometry or Attribute while Bake remains true does not bake again.
An empty ME Attribute is used when no attribute is supplied.
Group branch items is enabled by default and can be changed from the component context menu.
When grouping is enabled, each Grasshopper branch is placed into a separate Rhino group.
The component outputs a text message rather than baked geometry.
